unit: Resilient Cities Housing Initiative (RCHI), Department of Urban Studies and Planning

labs.pi_title: Director, RCHI; Ford Professor of Urban Design and Planning, MIT DUSP; Associate Dean, MIT School of Architecture and Planning
labs.research_summary: Investigates the challenges of developing housing environments for the least advantaged city dwellers, evaluating case studies worldwide against principles of livelihood, environment, governance and security.
